userStories.title: First-run onboarding: mic test, model download, hotkey practice
userStories.description: As a new user, I want to be dictating within 2 minutes (research section 4). Persist onboarding_done in Settings; never show again.

userStories.title: Transcription history with retention setting
userStories.description: As a user, I want to recover past dictations. Append (text, ISO timestamp, target app process name from the US-007 focus capture) to history.json after each successful transcription, cap 200 entries. New History section in the sidebar: newest-first rows (time, first line, target app), click-to-copy, Re-paste button via the existing paste path, per-row delete, Clear All. Setting history_retention_days (default 30, 0 = keep nothing) enforced by a startup purge. NO audio is ever retained (research: SuperWhisper is criticized for exactly that; text-only is the privacy stance).
acceptanceCriteria: Successful dictations append to history.json; failures do not; temp audio always deleted
History UI: copy, re-paste, delete, clear-all all work against the real file
history_retention_days persisted and enforced on startup, no polling
npm run build passes and cargo check passes

userStories.title: System tray, close-to-tray, launch at login
userStories.description: As a user, I expect a dictation utility to live in the tray, not die when I close a window. Tray icon (tauri tray-icon, reuse app icon) with menu: Open Demod, Show/Hide pill, Start/Stop dictation, Quit (only full-exit path, kills whisper-server via existing handler). 'Launch at login' toggle in General wired to the HKCU Run key pointing at the installed exe; on load, reflect true state and absorb the legacy Startup-folder shortcut that already exists on this machine (manage one mechanism, remove the other honestly).

userStories.title: Secure Groq key storage via DPAPI and key test button
userStories.description: As a user, I want my API key stored safely (research section 5: SuperWhisper stores keys plaintext and gets called out for it). Encrypt with Windows DPAPI (CryptProtectData, current-user scope), store base64 blob as groq_api_key_enc in config.json, decrypt transparently on load, migrate an existing plaintext key on first load and delete the plaintext field. Add a 'Test key' button calling Groq's models endpoint, showing ok/failure inline; the key never appears in logs or console.
acceptanceCriteria: No plaintext key in config.json after first run; DPAPI round-trip works; migration covered
Test key hits the real Groq endpoint and reports inline without logging the key
cargo check passes and npm run build passes

userStories.title: Failure honesty: server watchdog and error pill state
userStories.description: As a user, I need to know when dictation is broken instead of silence (user's standing rule: never fake, never silent). Add an 'error' pill state (pre-mounted layer, red tint, terse reason slot) per the wave-1 pattern; every Err path in stop_and_transcribe and the hotkey handlers must transition the overlay out of listening/processing (the pill must never stick in Transcribing). Detect whisper-server child exit via the shell plugin receiver: one auto-restart, then yellow status dot + error state if it dies again within a minute (no restart storm).
acceptanceCriteria: error state exists as a pre-mounted crossfade layer with a message slot
Grep-verifiable: no failure path leaves the overlay in listening/processing
whisper-server exit triggers exactly one auto-restart with surfaced backoff state
cargo check passes and npm run build passes
